result.note: Tested the defining fact that EOS-05, launched in September 2026, is India's first imaging satellite in geosynchronous orbit.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, ISRO launched EOS-05. It was described as India's first imaging satellite placed in which type of orbit?
questions.explain: EOS-05 is India's first geosynchronous-orbit imaging satellite. It can keep near-continuous watch over an area instead of passing over it every few days. This improves real-time tracking of cyclones, floods and borders.
questions.source: ISRO launched EOS-05, India's first geosynchronous-orbit imaging satellite, able to hold near-continuous watch over an area rather than passing over it every few days
